full_prompt_en: A square experimental mixed-media image forms a fragmented face-like profile from painterly stains, halftone dots, and overlapping colored circles on a pale paper ground. The background is off-white and densely perforated by black printed dots, most regular near the top and right edges. Near the center, a loosely assembled head shape turns toward the left. Its upper portion is mottled rose, mustard, and gray; a dark eye-like mark cuts across the middle, while blue-green staining gathers along the cheek. At the lower center, several green curved strokes suggest lips and a chin without becoming a conventional fully modeled portrait. A solid blue-violet disk floats on the left, partly covered by the dotted texture. On the right, a larger orange half-circle sits behind the head form, its clear curved edge providing a sharp counterweight to the irregular painted center. Small orange speckles spread around the face-like mass, and delicate thin lines trail into the lower white area. The colored layers are not confined by a single clean outline: watercolor-like washes bleed, rough printed fields overlap, and dark patches interrupt the head at different depths. Light is flat and paper-based rather than directional, so color and printing density create the apparent depth. The upper corners retain crisp mechanical dot grids, while the central paint is more smeared and tactile. No text or recognizable setting appears. The work holds the viewer between recognition and abstraction, using a few facial cues amid unrelated geometric and material marks. The overall composition is energetic but contained, balancing a colorful uneven center with large simple disks and a continuous pale printed ground.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形实验混合媒介图像在浅色纸底上用绘画污渍、网点与重叠彩色圆形组成一张碎片化的侧脸般形。背景为灰白，密布黑色印刷点，在顶部和右边缘最规则。中央附近，一团松散拼成的头形朝左。上部斑驳玫瑰色、芥黄和灰色；一道深色似眼痕切过中部，蓝绿污色聚在脸颊。下部中央几道绿色弯笔暗示嘴唇与下巴，却没有形成传统完整塑形肖像。左侧一枚蓝紫实色圆盘漂浮，被点纹部分覆盖。右侧更大的橙色半圆坐在头形后方，清楚弧边与不规则绘画中心形成尖锐对重。细小橙点撒在面孔似的体块周围，细线又拖入下方白区。彩色层次不被单一干净轮廓限制：水彩般渗化、粗印刷色域与深色斑块在不同深度叠压和切断头部。光平坦且属于纸面，不具定向性，颜色与印刷密度创造表观纵深。上角保留清楚机械点阵，中央颜料则更抹擦且有触感。没有文字或可辨场景。作品以少数面部线索夹在无关的几何与材料痕迹中，使观者在辨认与抽象之间徘徊。整体构图富动势但受控制，以彩色不均中央平衡大片简明圆盘和连续浅色印刷底。
style_prompt_en: Experimental mixed-media imagery overlaps mechanical halftone grids, translucent painterly washes, scraped dark marks, and bold flat circles. Off-white paper and black dot texture provide a continuous base, while mustard, orange, blue-violet, muted rose, and green appear in uneven concentrated patches. Precise geometric edges press against bleeding pigment and rubbed organic contours, creating tension between reproduction and handwork. Dot size and density vary, sometimes obscuring the color beneath and sometimes allowing it to show through. Light is graphic and even; perceived depth comes from opacity, overlap, and scale rather than cast shadow. Small scattered speckles bridge the gap between large disks and dense central texture. The composition concentrates complexity near the middle and leaves some pale margins open. The overall effect is layered, unstable, and lively, with surface process as visible as any implied form.
style_prompt_zh: 实验混合媒介影像叠放机械网点、半透明绘画渗色、刮擦深痕和大胆平面圆形。灰白纸与黑点肌理提供连续底面，芥黄、橙、蓝紫、灰玫瑰和绿以不均匀的集中色斑出现。精确几何边缘挤着渗开的颜料和擦磨有机轮廓，在复制感与手工之间形成张力。点的大小和密度变化，有时遮住下面的颜色，有时让其透出。光图形化而均匀；表观纵深来自透明度、重叠和尺度，而非投影。散落小点连起大圆盘与密集中央肌理。构图把复杂度集中在中部，仍给部分浅色边缘留空。整体效果层叠、不稳定而有生气，表面过程与任何暗示的形体同样可见。
theme_en: A fragmented face-like collage amid halftone dots and orange circles
theme_zh: 网点与橙色圆形之间的一张碎片化面部拼贴
name: Sigmar Polke
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
